title: {{NAME}} and the Magical Kickabout
moral: It is always more fun when everyone gets a turn.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} walked through a glowing metal gate.
Inside was the most amazing soccer pitch.
Cool robots practised kicks on one side.
A herd of unicorns grazed on the other.
{{NAME}} looked left and looked right and smiled.

pages.content:
A little green robot rolled up to {{NAME}}.
"The unicorns won't play with us," it said sadly.
{{NAME}}'s eyes went wide with surprise.
"Why not?" he asked.
"They think the ball will hurt them," it beeped.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} had an idea.
He asked the robots to kick the ball softly.
One by one the unicorns came over.
{{NAME}} showed them how to tap the ball gently.
Soon everyone was playing together!

pages.content:
A unicorn kicked the ball too hard.
It flew and hit a robot on the head.
The robot beeped and wobbled.
{{NAME}} held his breath.
Then the robot giggled a funny robot giggle.

pages.content:
Everyone laughed so hard.
Robots and unicorns played together all afternoon.
{{NAME}} sat in the soft grass feeling happy.
His eyes grew heavy and slow.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. What a special day.
I wonder who will score the first goal tomorrow.
